description: Score the user's own answers to a GATE Daily set the way GATE does (a wrong MCQ costs 1/3 or 2/3 of its marks; MSQ and NAT have no negative marking and no partial credit) and get the answer, worked solution and a note to remember for every question. Call it once, after the user has answered, with only the answers the user gave, never answers you worked out; questions left out count as skipped. An MCQ takes exactly one option. For a signed-in user the set is saved to their record (the first submission of a set stays).

answers.description: Question number to the user's answer: one option letter for an MCQ ("b"), every chosen letter for an MSQ (["a","c"]), a number for a NAT ("12.5"). MCQ and MSQ answers must be option letters only; anything else is sent back unscored. null, "" or [] leaves a question blank.

date.description: The set's date, YYYY-MM-DD, as get_daily_set or get_subject_set returned it.

subject.description: For a subject set: its subject code, as get_subject_set returned it. Leave out for the daily set.

times.description: Milliseconds the user spent per question, when known (the quiz card sends it).

name: submit_answers

timeSec.description: about how long the question should take, in seconds

options.description: the correct option letters (MCQ: one, MSQ: one or more)

ranges.description: NAT: an answer in any of these ranges is correct

saved.description: whether the set is on the user's GATE Daily record

title: Submit answers
